forbiddenShortcuts.post_boundary_release_on_reconcile: Releasing a post-boundary receive at all, even on a reconcile-first, T0-unchanged, fully-acked read — no post-boundary release is permitted; a head-unchanged snapshot is not proof a signed tx will never land.
forbiddenShortcuts.evidence_disposal_on_expiry: Discarding persisted evidence when a receive expires (post-boundary must retain all evidence).
forbiddenShortcuts.lease_drop_before_disposition: Dropping the lease before a disposition (RECEIVE_LANDED / INDETERMINATE) is reached.
